package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	status "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/decl/components/status"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/badge"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/status"
	"github.com/orbit-z/orbit"
)

func main() {
	items := []any{1, "two", true, false, status.Video{Title: "v"}, []int{}, []int{1, 2}, nil, 2.5}
	for _, p := range []status.Props{
		{Status: "draft", N: 0},
		{Status: "queued", N: 3, Items: items},
		{Status: "published", N: 12},
	} {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		if err := status.Render(&orbit.Ctx{}, orbit.NewWriter(&buf), p, orbit.Slots{}); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		fmt.Println(buf.String())
		fmt.Println("--")
	}
}
